of growing up.

What would you like to know?

BEFORE YOU GET IN TOUCH

A few questions
parents often ask.

Can I visit the school?+

Try the enquiry form to see how a visit request reaches the admin workspace. A school can add its actual contact details here.

Where can I find the official fee structure?+

Schools can add their current fee structure here. Explore the sample fee ledger to see collections and receipts. All demo amounts are fictional.

Can I actually use the demo panels?+

Yes. Add a student as an admin, publish homework as a teacher, and submit it as a student. Changes are saved locally in this browser. Reset demo in Settings starts over.

Where are the school’s official disclosures?+

Each school can add its affiliation details, policies and required disclosure documents here. No affiliation is claimed by this demo.
